topics.name: Quantum state and channel learning
topics.description: Papers that bound the samples and queries needed to learn unknown states, channels and measurements, including shadow tomography and online learning.

topics.name: Machine learning for molecules and materials
topics.description: Papers that combine classical or quantum machine learning with electronic-structure methods to predict molecular energies, potentials and material properties.

topics.name: Quantum PAC learning theory
topics.description: Papers that prove sample-complexity bounds and quantum-classical separations for learning classical concepts in PAC and statistical-query models.

topics.name: Machine-learned entanglement detection
topics.description: Papers that train neural networks and other classifiers to detect, classify or quantify entanglement from partial measurement data.

topics.name: Hamiltonian learning
topics.description: Papers that recover the Hamiltonian or Lindbladian of a many-body system from its dynamics, often with Heisenberg-limited scaling.

topics.name: Machine learning of phases of matter
topics.description: Papers that classify quantum phases and detect phase transitions with supervised, unsupervised or quantum machine learning on many-body data.

topics.name: Neural quantum states
topics.description: Papers that represent many-body wavefunctions with neural networks and optimise them by variational Monte Carlo.

topics.name: Quantum clustering algorithms
topics.description: Papers that give quantum and hybrid algorithms for k-means, spectral and correlation clustering, including coreset constructions with provable speed-ups.

topics.name: Quantum generative models
topics.description: Papers that train quantum circuit Born machines, IQP-based and diffusion-style generative models to learn and sample probability distributions.

topics.name: Quantum generative adversarial networks
topics.description: Papers that design and train quantum and hybrid GANs, mostly for image and tabular data generation, and study mode collapse.

topics.name: Quantum graph neural networks
topics.description: Papers that build quantum and hybrid graph neural networks and quantum graph embeddings for learning on graph-structured data.

topics.name: Quantum reservoir computing
topics.description: Papers that use the fixed dynamics of spin, oscillator and photonic systems as reservoirs for time-series prediction, with trained classical readout.

topics.name: Tensor-network machine learning
topics.description: Papers that use matrix product states and other tensor networks as classifiers and generative models, and study their training.

topics.name: Quantum physics-informed neural networks
topics.description: Papers that solve ordinary and partial differential equations with quantum or hybrid physics-informed neural networks.

topics.name: Geometric quantum machine learning
topics.description: Papers that build symmetry-equivariant quantum neural networks from group representation theory to improve trainability and generalisation.

topics.name: Quantum time-series forecasting
topics.description: Papers that forecast weather, energy and financial time series with quantum LSTMs, variational circuits and other hybrid sequence models.

topics.name: Photonic quantum neural networks
topics.description: Papers that implement neural networks and classifiers on linear-optical and other photonic hardware, classical or quantum.

topics.name: QML security and anomaly detection
topics.description: Papers that study adversarial and backdoor attacks on quantum classifiers, or apply QML to intrusion and anomaly detection.

topics.name: Quantum federated learning
topics.description: Papers that train quantum or hybrid models across distributed clients without sharing data, with privacy and communication constraints.

topics.name: QML for medical data
topics.description: Papers that apply quantum and hybrid classifiers to medical images, clinical records and biomedical signals, mostly as benchmarks against classical models.

topics.name: Quantum kernel methods
topics.description: Papers that build, train and benchmark quantum kernels and quantum support vector machines, including their concentration and scaling.

topics.name: Quantum and hybrid neural networks
topics.description: Papers that design quantum convolutional and hybrid quantum-classical neural networks and test them on image classification benchmarks.

topics.name: Quantum machine learning surveys
topics.description: Papers that review quantum machine learning as a whole: data encoding, model families, hardware readiness and claimed advantages.

topics.name: Variational quantum classifiers
topics.description: Papers that design variational quantum classifiers, especially multiclass schemes, ensembles, data re-uploading and output encodings.

topics.name: QML for financial prediction
topics.description: Papers that apply quantum and hybrid classifiers and regressors to credit risk, fraud detection and stock-return prediction.

topics.name: Option pricing with amplitude estimation
topics.description: Papers that price derivatives and estimate financial risk with quantum amplitude estimation as a quadratic speed-up over Monte Carlo.

topics.name: Portfolio optimisation
topics.description: Papers that cast portfolio selection as QUBO or constrained problems and solve them with QAOA, VQE, annealing and decomposition pipelines.

topics.name: Quantum computer music
topics.description: Papers that compose, synthesise and sonify music and sound with quantum circuits, annealers and quantum data.

topics.name: LLM agents for quantum computing
topics.description: Papers that use large language models and AI agents to write quantum code, design experiments, run hardware and answer physics questions.

topics.name: Quantum natural language processing
topics.description: Papers that build compositional (DisCoCat, DisCoCirc) and attention-based quantum models for text classification and generation.

topics.name: Quantum education and workforce
topics.description: Papers that design and evaluate quantum courses, outreach and training programmes, and survey students, instructors and industry needs.

topics.name: Quantum-like models of cognition
topics.description: Papers that model human decision-making, opinion dynamics and language with quantum probability and open-system formalisms.

topics.name: Compilation for neutral-atom arrays
topics.description: Papers that compile, route and schedule circuits on neutral-atom arrays using atom movement, zoned architectures and native multi-qubit gates.

topics.name: Shortcuts to adiabaticity
topics.description: Papers that speed up adiabatic state transfer and preparation with counterdiabatic driving, invariant-based inverse engineering and related shortcuts.

topics.name: Rydberg arrays for independent sets
topics.description: Papers that encode maximum independent set and other graph problems in Rydberg atom arrays via the blockade, and assess hardness and speed-ups.

topics.name: Classical simulation of noisy circuits
topics.description: Papers that classically simulate or sample from noisy and random quantum circuits (Pauli propagation, frame methods) and locate where advantage can begin.

topics.name: Minor embedding and annealer benchmarks
topics.description: Papers that embed optimisation problems into D-Wave hardware graphs, tune chain strengths and schedules, and benchmark annealer generations.

topics.name: Quantum annealing dynamics
topics.description: Papers that study annealing schedules, energy gaps, diabatic and reverse annealing, catalysts and decoherence in transverse-field Ising annealing.

topics.name: Fermion-to-qubit mappings and Hubbard simulation
topics.description: Papers that design fermion-to-qubit encodings and circuits for simulating Fermi-Hubbard and other fermionic models on digital hardware.

topics.name: Analog and digital-analog simulation
topics.description: Papers that analyse the accuracy, error propagation, verification and programming of analog and digital-analog quantum simulators.

topics.name: Adiabatic quantum computation
topics.description: Papers that analyse adiabatic algorithms for state preparation, optimisation and linear systems, including runtime bounds and discretised adiabatic evolution.

topics.name: Trotter error and product formulas
topics.description: Papers that bound, estimate and reduce Trotter error, and design higher-order, randomised and multi-product formulas for Hamiltonian simulation.

topics.name: Quantum imaginary-time evolution
topics.description: Papers that implement imaginary-time evolution on quantum hardware (QITE, probabilistic and variational variants) to prepare ground and thermal states.

topics.name: Quantum impurity solvers for DMFT
topics.description: Papers that compute Green's functions of Anderson impurity models on quantum hardware as solvers for dynamical mean-field theory.

topics.name: Quantum Krylov and subspace diagonalisation
topics.description: Papers that estimate eigenvalues by projecting Hamiltonians onto quantum-generated Krylov or sampled subspaces, including sample-based Krylov diagonalisation.

topics.name: VQE for lattice and nuclear models
topics.description: Papers that apply variational quantum eigensolvers to Hubbard, Heisenberg and nuclear shell-model Hamiltonians and benchmark ansatz choices.

topics.name: VQE for molecular electronic structure
topics.description: Papers that compute molecular ground and excited states with VQE, ADAPT and related ansatze, and benchmark them for quantum chemistry.

topics.name: Robust quantum optimal control
topics.description: Papers that design control pulses insensitive to drift, model errors and noise, and quantify the cost of that robustness.

topics.name: Quantum optimal control theory
topics.description: Papers that apply Pontryagin's principle, invariants and Krotov-type methods to steer closed and open systems, including incoherent and feedback control.

topics.name: GRAPE and numerical pulse optimisation
topics.description: Papers that develop gradient-based and global numerical solvers and software packages for quantum optimal control problems.

topics.name: Reinforcement learning for quantum control
topics.description: Papers that train reinforcement-learning agents to design pulses, feedback, readout and cooling protocols for quantum devices.

topics.name: Quantum reinforcement learning
topics.description: Papers that build reinforcement-learning agents from variational circuits or quantum subroutines and test them on classical environments.

topics.name: RL for circuit synthesis and compilation
topics.description: Papers that use reinforcement learning to synthesise, optimise and route quantum circuits and to search circuit architectures.

topics.name: Protein folding and drug discovery
topics.description: Papers that map protein folding, side-chain placement, docking and peptide design to QUBOs and variational algorithms.

topics.name: Quantum algorithms for genomics
topics.description: Papers that apply quantum search, annealing and optimisation to sequence alignment, genome assembly, phylogenetics and mRNA design.

topics.name: Quantum continuous optimisation
topics.description: Papers that give quantum algorithms and query bounds for convex, nonconvex and stochastic optimisation, including Hamiltonian descent and interior-point methods.

topics.name: Power-grid optimisation
topics.description: Papers that apply QAOA, annealing and quantum linear solvers to unit commitment, power flow and other electricity-grid problems.

topics.name: Routing, scheduling and logistics
topics.description: Papers that formulate travelling-salesman, vehicle-routing, scheduling and packing problems as QUBOs and solve them with quantum and hybrid solvers.

topics.name: QAOA performance and parameter setting
topics.description: Papers that analyse, train, transfer parameters for and benchmark the quantum approximate optimisation algorithm (QAOA), including constrained mixers.

topics.name: QUBO formulations and solvers
topics.description: Papers that build, compress and encode quadratic unconstrained binary optimisation (QUBO) formulations and benchmark quantum and classical QUBO solvers.

topics.name: QSP, QSVT and block encodings
topics.description: Papers that develop quantum signal processing, singular-value transformation and block encodings as general tools for polynomial transformations of matrices.

topics.name: Quantum linear system solvers
topics.description: Papers that design, optimise and compare HHL and later quantum linear-system algorithms, including variational and quantum-inspired solvers.

topics.name: Quantum algorithms for differential equations
topics.description: Papers that solve linear and nonlinear ODEs and PDEs on quantum computers via Schrödingerisation, Carleman linearisation and variational methods.

topics.name: Quantum lattice Boltzmann and CFD
topics.description: Papers that simulate classical fluid flow on quantum computers, mostly through lattice Boltzmann and Carleman-linearised schemes.

topics.name: Barren plateaus and VQA training
topics.description: Papers that analyse trainability of variational quantum algorithms: barren plateaus, initialisation, gradient estimation and optimisers.

topics.name: Magic state distillation and cultivation
topics.description: Papers that design and cost magic-state distillation, cultivation and injection protocols for fault-tolerant non-Clifford gates.

topics.name: Quantum error mitigation
topics.description: Papers that develop and benchmark zero-noise extrapolation, probabilistic error cancellation, readout correction and other mitigation methods on noisy hardware.

topics.name: Floquet codes
topics.description: Papers that construct and analyse dynamical (Floquet) codes generated by periodic sequences of non-commuting two-qubit measurements.

topics.name: QEC benchmarking and realistic noise
topics.description: Papers that simulate, benchmark and teach quantum error correction under realistic hardware noise such as crosstalk, drift and readout error.

topics.name: Fault-tolerant gadgets and syndrome extraction
topics.description: Papers that design flag-based syndrome extraction, error-detecting codes and low-overhead fault-tolerant state preparation and logic.

topics.name: Surface-code decoders
topics.description: Papers that build matching, belief-propagation and neural-network decoders for surface and colour codes, with attention to real-time latency.

topics.name: Stabilizer code constructions
topics.description: Papers that construct stabilizer and non-stabilizer codes algebraically, including qudit and mixed-dimension codes, and study their structure.

topics.name: Transversal and non-Clifford logical gates
topics.description: Papers that find codes supporting transversal, fold-transversal and constant-depth logical gates, especially non-Clifford gates on CSS and qLDPC codes.

topics.name: Decoders for qLDPC codes
topics.description: Papers that design belief-propagation-based and other decoders for quantum low-density parity-check codes, including bivariate bicycle codes.

topics.name: Low-overhead qLDPC architectures
topics.description: Papers that lay out quantum low-density parity-check codes on realistic hardware connectivity and perform logical operations on them with low overhead.

topics.name: GPU and HPC circuit simulators
topics.description: Papers that build and benchmark state-vector and hybrid circuit simulators on GPUs, supercomputers and other accelerators.

topics.name: Tensor-network circuit simulation
topics.description: Papers that simulate quantum circuits with matrix product states and other tensor networks, and compile tensor networks into shallow circuits.

topics.name: Distributed quantum computing
topics.description: Papers that partition, compile and schedule circuits across networked quantum processors linked by teleported gates and shared entanglement.

topics.name: Circuit cutting
topics.description: Papers that split large circuits into smaller subcircuits by gate and wire cuts and reduce the resulting sampling overhead.

topics.name: Benchmarking quantum computers
topics.description: Papers that define and run application-level and holistic benchmarks such as quantum volume to compare quantum processors and software stacks.

topics.name: Qubit mapping and routing
topics.description: Papers that map logical qubits to hardware and insert SWAPs to satisfy connectivity, with exact, heuristic and benchmarked routers.

topics.name: Quantum-HPC integration and cloud
topics.description: Papers that integrate quantum processors into HPC centres and cloud services: software stacks, scheduling, orchestration and hybrid workflows.

topics.name: Randomized benchmarking
topics.description: Papers that design and analyse randomized benchmarking, cross-entropy and related protocols for estimating gate error rates.

topics.name: Quantum image representation
topics.description: Papers that encode, compress, transform and encrypt classical images in quantum states (FRQI, NEQR and successors).

topics.name: Measurement-based quantum computation
topics.description: Papers that compile circuits into measurement patterns on graph and cluster states, and study flow, universality and MBQC resources.

topics.name: Shor's algorithm and cryptanalysis
topics.description: Papers that implement, optimise and cost Shor-type factoring and discrete-logarithm algorithms, and assess alternative factoring claims.

topics.name: ZX-calculus and graphical languages
topics.description: Papers that develop ZX, ZH and ZXW diagrammatic calculi, prove completeness, and use rewriting for circuits and verification.

topics.name: Quantum Fourier transform circuits
topics.description: Papers that design faster, shallower and hardware-mapped quantum Fourier transform circuits and related transforms.

topics.name: Quantum arithmetic circuits
topics.description: Papers that design adders, multipliers, comparators and modular arithmetic with low Toffoli, T and ancilla counts.

topics.name: Quantum state preparation
topics.description: Papers that prepare arbitrary, sparse and structured quantum states with optimal depth and ancilla trade-offs.

topics.name: Quantum programming languages and verification
topics.description: Papers that design quantum programming languages, intermediate representations and semantics, and formally verify quantum programs.

topics.name: Quantum software testing and debugging
topics.description: Papers that test, debug and study bugs in quantum programs, libraries and simulators with software-engineering methods.

topics.name: Multi-controlled gate decomposition
topics.description: Papers that decompose multi-controlled and general unitaries into CNOTs and single-qubit gates with fewer gates or lower depth.

topics.name: Clifford+T synthesis and circuit optimisation
topics.description: Papers that synthesise and optimise circuits over Clifford+T and other gate sets, minimising T-count, CNOT count and depth.

topics.name: Graph and hypergraph states
topics.description: Papers that classify and construct graph and hypergraph states and relate their entanglement to graph-theoretic structure such as vertex-minors.

topics.name: Entanglement monogamy relations
topics.description: Papers that derive tighter monogamy and polygamy inequalities for concurrence, negativity and other entanglement measures in multi-qubit systems.

topics.name: Nonlocality without entanglement
topics.description: Papers that construct sets of orthogonal product states that cannot be distinguished by local operations and classical communication (LOCC).

topics.name: Entanglement detection and measures
topics.description: Papers that derive separability criteria, entanglement witnesses and measures for bipartite and multipartite states, including moment-based tests.

topics.name: Local-unitary invariants and AME states
topics.description: Papers that classify multipartite entanglement by local-unitary invariants and construct absolutely maximally entangled states and perfect tensors.

topics.name: Bell inequalities and nonlocality
topics.description: Papers that construct and optimise Bell inequalities, quantify nonlocality, and study sequential sharing of Bell violations.

topics.name: Network nonlocality
topics.description: Papers that study nonlocal correlations in networks with independent sources, such as triangle and bilocal networks.

topics.name: Quantum optimal transport
topics.description: Papers that define quantum Wasserstein distances and optimal-transport costs between states and channels and prove their metric properties.

topics.name: Information geometry and wavefunction entropies
topics.description: Papers that study metrics on quantum state space, or compute Shannon, Fisher and Rényi entropies for exactly solvable potentials.

topics.name: Quantum Markov semigroups and dynamical maps
topics.description: Papers that characterise completely positive dynamical maps, Markov semigroups, their generators, divisibility and relaxation rates.

topics.name: Quantum non-Markovianity
topics.description: Papers that define, witness and quantify memory effects in open quantum dynamics, including multi-time processes and quantum versus classical memory.

topics.name: Kirkwood-Dirac quasiprobability
topics.description: Papers that study Kirkwood-Dirac quasiprobability distributions, their nonpositivity and links to weak values, coherence and quantum advantage.

topics.name: Quantum relative entropies and divergences
topics.description: Papers that prove continuity, data-processing and operational results for von Neumann, Rényi and f-divergence quantities.

topics.name: Magic and stabilizer Rényi entropy
topics.description: Papers that quantify nonstabilizerness (magic) with stabilizer Rényi entropies and other monotones, especially in many-body states and circuits.

topics.name: Purification, cloning and channel supermaps
topics.description: Papers that bound and construct protocols for purifying, cloning, storing and transforming unknown states and channels, including the random purification channel.

topics.name: Fidelity and trace-distance estimation
topics.description: Papers that give sample- and query-optimal algorithms for estimating fidelity, trace distance, purity and state-power traces.

topics.name: General quantum resource theories
topics.description: Papers that develop the general framework of quantum resource theories: monotones, robustness, convertibility and dynamical resources.

topics.name: Coherence and imaginarity resource theories
topics.description: Papers that quantify quantum coherence and imaginarity as resources and relate them to metrology, algorithms and state transformations.

topics.name: Channel capacities and quantum Shannon theory
topics.description: Papers that bound classical and quantum capacities of channels, prove achievability and converse results, and study communication complexity.

topics.name: Measurement incompatibility
topics.description: Papers that characterise, quantify and certify incompatibility of measurements and instruments and its role in operational tasks.

topics.name: Uncertainty relations
topics.description: Papers that derive tighter variance-based, entropic and skew-information uncertainty relations, including memory-assisted versions.

topics.name: EPR steering
topics.description: Papers that detect, quantify and share Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen steering in bipartite, multipartite and network scenarios.

topics.name: State and channel discrimination
topics.description: Papers that find optimal minimum-error, unambiguous and sequential strategies for discriminating quantum states and channels, and their limits.

topics.name: Categorical quantum mechanics
topics.description: Papers that formalise quantum processes, supermaps and subsystems with monoidal, dagger and Markov categories and linear logic.

topics.name: Mutually unbiased bases
topics.description: Papers that construct, classify and bound sets of mutually unbiased bases and complex Hadamard matrices, especially in dimension six.

topics.name: Majorization and matrix inequalities
topics.description: Papers that prove majorization relations, norm and trace inequalities and related results in matrix analysis used in quantum information.

topics.name: Positive and completely positive maps
topics.description: Papers that characterise positive, k-positive and completely positive maps on matrix and operator algebras, including Choi-type maps and dilations.

topics.name: Quantum walk spatial search
topics.description: Papers that design and analyse spatial search for marked vertices with coined, Szegedy and continuous-time quantum walks on graphs.

topics.name: Discrete-time quantum walk dynamics
topics.description: Papers that study spreading, localisation, decoherence and entanglement of coined and continuous-time quantum walks on lattices.

topics.name: Perfect state transfer on graphs
topics.description: Papers that characterise perfect and pretty good state transfer of quantum walks on graph families using spectral graph theory.

topics.name: Local Hamiltonian complexity
topics.description: Papers that classify the complexity of ground-state and Gibbs-state problems for local Hamiltonians and give classical approximation algorithms.

topics.name: Quantum topological data analysis
topics.description: Papers that estimate Betti numbers and persistent homology with quantum algorithms and prove hardness results for these tasks.

topics.name: Hidden subgroup and group problems
topics.description: Papers that solve hidden subgroup, isomorphism and representation-theoretic problems over groups with quantum algorithms, and bound their complexity.

topics.name: Nonlocal games and quantum game theory
topics.description: Papers that analyse quantum strategies in nonlocal games such as CHSH and magic square, or quantise classical games with Nash equilibria.

topics.name: Quantum graph algorithms
topics.description: Papers that give quantum query and time bounds for graph problems such as cuts, cycles, triangles and treewidth.

topics.name: Unitary designs and pseudorandom unitaries
topics.description: Papers that construct approximate unitary t-designs and pseudorandom unitaries from shallow random circuits, including under symmetries.

topics.name: Grover search and amplitude amplification
topics.description: Papers that modify, implement and analyse Grover's search and amplitude amplification, including deterministic, qudit and NISQ variants.

topics.name: Quantum query complexity
topics.description: Papers that prove quantum query upper and lower bounds and separations for Boolean functions, search problems and adaptivity.

topics.name: QMA and quantum proof systems
topics.description: Papers that study QMA, QCMA, quantum PCPs and interactive proofs, including oracle separations and complexity-class collapses.

topics.name: Quantum secret sharing
topics.description: Papers that design threshold and other quantum secret sharing schemes, their codes, access structures and rates.

topics.name: Multiparty and semi-quantum key protocols
topics.description: Papers that propose conference key agreement, semi-quantum key distribution, quantum dialogue and anonymous multiparty key protocols.

topics.name: Satellite and free-space QKD
topics.description: Papers that model and demonstrate quantum key distribution over satellite downlinks and terrestrial free-space links, including turbulence and scheduling.

topics.name: QKD information reconciliation
topics.description: Papers that design LDPC, polar and other error-correction schemes for reconciling keys in discrete- and continuous-variable QKD.

topics.name: Twin-field and MDI QKD
topics.description: Papers that implement and extend twin-field and measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution for long distances and networks.

topics.name: Continuous-variable QKD
topics.description: Papers that develop and demonstrate continuous-variable QKD with Gaussian and discrete modulation, local local oscillators and composable security.

topics.name: Practical QKD security and attacks
topics.description: Papers that prove finite-key security of practical decoy-state QKD and analyse source and detector imperfections and attacks.

topics.name: Device-independent QKD
topics.description: Papers that bound key rates and prove security of device-independent quantum key distribution based on Bell violations.

topics.name: Quantum differential privacy
topics.description: Papers that define and analyse differential privacy and related privacy notions for quantum states, channels and algorithms.

topics.name: Private distributed quantum sensing
topics.description: Papers that estimate global functions with networks of quantum sensors while keeping local parameters private or secure against eavesdroppers.

topics.name: Quantum money, blockchain and voting
topics.description: Papers that design quantum money and tokens, quantum or post-quantum blockchains, Byzantine agreement and voting protocols, and assess quantum threats to cryptocurrencies.

topics.name: Blind and delegated quantum computation
topics.description: Papers that let clients delegate quantum computations to untrusted servers with blindness, verifiability or homomorphic encryption.

topics.name: Quantum cryptographic primitives
topics.description: Papers that construct and separate quantum cryptographic primitives such as commitments, oblivious transfer, unclonable and one-shot signatures, and one-way state generators.

topics.name: Pseudorandom states and unitaries
topics.description: Papers that construct, separate and bound pseudorandom quantum states, function-like states and unitaries as cryptographic primitives.

topics.name: Certified quantum randomness
topics.description: Papers that certify and bound randomness in device-independent and semi-device-independent scenarios, including guessing probabilities.

topics.name: Quantum random number generators
topics.description: Papers that build and characterise quantum random number generators from vacuum noise, phase noise and other sources, including source-independent designs.

topics.name: Self-testing of states and measurements
topics.description: Papers that self-test entangled states and measurements from observed correlations, in Bell and prepare-and-measure scenarios.

topics.name: Quantum-limited optical receivers
topics.description: Papers that design receivers approaching the Helstrom and Holevo limits for coherent-state optical communication, including joint-detection schemes.

topics.name: Entanglement distribution over deployed fibre
topics.description: Papers that distribute polarisation and other entanglement over metropolitan fibre networks, including coexistence with classical traffic.

topics.name: Quantum time synchronisation
topics.description: Papers that synchronise clocks and transfer time over fibre and free space with entangled photons and quantum network protocols.

topics.name: Optical quantum memories
topics.description: Papers that store and retrieve photonic qubits in atomic, rare-earth and integrated memories, with attention to efficiency, lifetime and multimode capacity.

topics.name: Heralded photonic entanglement
topics.description: Papers that generate and measure Bell, GHZ and high-dimensional entangled photon states with linear optics and heralding.

topics.name: Photonic cluster states and fusion
topics.description: Papers that generate photonic graph and cluster states from emitters or linear optics and build fusion-based fault-tolerant architectures.

topics.name: Programmable photonic processors
topics.description: Papers that design, characterise and benchmark reconfigurable integrated interferometer meshes and photonic processors for quantum light.

topics.name: Frequency-bin photonic qudits
topics.description: Papers that generate and manipulate frequency-bin entangled photons and qudits on chips with microresonators and electro-optic gates.

topics.name: Quantum energy teleportation
topics.description: Papers that extract energy remotely from entangled many-body ground states using local measurements and classical communication.

topics.name: Teleportation protocols and fidelity
topics.description: Papers that design teleportation protocols (qudit, bidirectional, port-based, noisy) and analyse their fidelity and resource requirements.

topics.name: Continuous-variable teleportation
topics.description: Papers that teleport continuous-variable and hybrid states using squeezed, photon-subtracted and other non-Gaussian entangled resources.

topics.name: Entanglement distillation protocols
topics.description: Papers that design and bound protocols converting many noisy entangled pairs into fewer high-fidelity pairs by local operations.

topics.name: Entanglement purification in networks
topics.description: Papers that analyse and optimise entanglement purification within network operation, including memory decoherence, buffering and asymmetric inputs.

topics.name: Satellite entanglement distribution
topics.description: Papers that model satellite and high-altitude platform architectures for global entanglement distribution and quantum internet backbones.

topics.name: Quantum internet architecture and simulators
topics.description: Papers that propose quantum network stacks and architectures and build discrete-event simulators and software for designing them.

topics.name: Entanglement routing
topics.description: Papers that route bipartite and multipartite entanglement across network topologies with multipath and graph-state methods.

topics.name: Quantum repeater chains
topics.description: Papers that analyse rates and fidelity of memory-based and all-photonic quantum repeaters with entanglement swapping and multiplexing.

topics.name: Boson sampling
topics.description: Papers that analyse the hardness, classical simulation and experimental validation of boson sampling and Gaussian boson sampling.

topics.name: Qubit noise spectroscopy
topics.description: Papers that measure and model the spectra and correlations of qubit dephasing noise with pulse sequences and repeated Ramsey measurements.

topics.name: Quantum amplitude estimation
topics.description: Papers that design low-depth, maximum-likelihood, Bayesian and parallel variants of quantum amplitude estimation.

topics.name: Quantum parameter estimation theory
topics.description: Papers that derive quantum Cramér-Rao and Bayesian bounds, multiparameter limits and optimal strategies for quantum metrology, including under noise.

topics.name: Classical shadows
topics.description: Papers that develop and analyse classical-shadow protocols for predicting many observables from randomised measurements, including process and fermionic shadows.

topics.name: Quantum state and process tomography
topics.description: Papers that reconstruct quantum states, processes and measurements from data, with adaptive, compressed and noise-aware tomography methods.

topics.name: Quantum phase estimation
topics.description: Papers that design and cost quantum phase estimation variants, especially low-depth and statistical versions for early fault-tolerant ground-state energy estimation.

topics.name: Optical cat and Fock state generation
topics.description: Papers that prepare Schrödinger cat, Fock and other non-Gaussian states of light and bosonic modes, often by heralded photon subtraction.

topics.name: Nonclassicality and non-Gaussianity of light
topics.description: Papers that quantify and detect nonclassicality, Wigner negativity and non-Gaussianity of optical states, including photon-added and subtracted states.

topics.name: Hong-Ou-Mandel interference
topics.description: Papers that study two-photon and multi-photon interference, indistinguishability and Hong-Ou-Mandel effects in theory and experiment.

topics.name: Wave-particle duality and complementarity
topics.description: Papers that test and quantify wave-particle duality, which-path information, quantum erasers and complementarity in interferometers.

topics.name: Continuous-variable entanglement criteria
topics.description: Papers that derive entanglement witnesses and separability criteria for Gaussian and non-Gaussian continuous-variable states.

topics.name: Quantum illumination
topics.description: Papers that analyse entanglement-enhanced target detection with two-mode squeezed light in noisy, lossy environments, and its receivers and limits.

topics.name: Quantum radar and lidar
topics.description: Papers that model and demonstrate quantum-enhanced radar and lidar for ranging, velocity estimation and jamming resistance.

topics.name: Ghost imaging and undetected photons
topics.description: Papers that image with photon-pair correlations: ghost imaging, imaging with undetected photons, quantum OCT and entangled-photon microscopy.

topics.name: Superresolution by mode demultiplexing
topics.description: Papers that resolve incoherent point sources below the Rayleigh limit with spatial-mode demultiplexing and quantum-limited estimation.

topics.name: Single-photon avalanche diodes
topics.description: Papers that design, model and calibrate SPAD and InGaAs single-photon detectors, including dark counts, afterpulsing and efficiency.

topics.name: Superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors
topics.description: Papers that develop SNSPDs and arrays with high efficiency, low jitter, mid-infrared response and photon-number resolution.

topics.name: Electrons on helium and neon
topics.description: Papers that trap and control single electrons on liquid helium or solid neon surfaces as qubits.

topics.name: Microwave-optical transduction
topics.description: Papers that convert quantum signals between microwave and optical frequencies to link superconducting qubits over distance.

topics.name: Single microwave photon detection
topics.description: Papers that detect, count and generate single itinerant microwave photons using superconducting circuits.

topics.name: Josephson parametric amplifiers
topics.description: Papers that build Josephson and travelling-wave parametric amplifiers for near quantum-limited microwave amplification.

topics.name: Cryogenic control electronics and wiring
topics.description: Papers that develop cryogenic electronics, wiring, filtering and calibrated measurement setups for millikelvin quantum devices.

topics.name: Superconducting circuit quantisation
topics.description: Papers that derive Hamiltonians for superconducting circuits from lumped-element or electromagnetic models of their environment.

topics.name: Dispersive readout and Purcell filters
topics.description: Papers that speed up and improve dispersive readout of superconducting qubits, often with Purcell filters protecting coherence.

topics.name: Quasiparticles and radiation-induced errors
topics.description: Papers that measure and mitigate quasiparticle poisoning and correlated errors from cosmic rays and radioactivity in superconducting qubits.

topics.name: Superconducting qubit gates and couplers
topics.description: Papers that design two-qubit gates, tunable couplers and crosstalk suppression for transmon and fluxonium processors.

topics.name: Superconducting materials and fabrication
topics.description: Papers that improve films, junctions, substrates and fabrication steps to cut loss in superconducting resonators and qubits.

topics.name: Two-level system defects
topics.description: Papers that characterise microscopic two-level system defects and their effect on superconducting qubit coherence and stability.

topics.name: Qubit control systems and calibration
topics.description: Papers that build FPGA and RFSoC control stacks and software for calibrating and running superconducting qubits.

topics.name: Quantum batteries
topics.description: Papers that model charging, storage and work extraction (ergotropy) in quantum batteries and look for collective charging advantages.

topics.name: Quantum synchronisation
topics.description: Papers that study synchronisation of quantum self-sustained oscillators and spins, including van der Pol models and experiments.

topics.name: Dissipative entanglement stabilisation
topics.description: Papers that use engineered dissipation and reservoirs to prepare and stabilise entangled steady states of qubits.

topics.name: Spin-chain quantum state transfer
topics.description: Papers that design spin-chain couplings and protocols for perfect or high-fidelity transfer of quantum states.

topics.name: Kerr-cat and bosonic oscillator qubits
topics.description: Papers that control Kerr parametric oscillators, cat qubits and nonlinear bosonic modes, including multiphoton dissipation and gates.

topics.name: STIRAP and adiabatic population transfer
topics.description: Papers that design stimulated Raman adiabatic passage and related pulse schemes for population transfer in multilevel systems.

topics.name: Quantum heat engines and refrigerators
topics.description: Papers that analyse Otto cycles and other quantum heat engines and refrigerators for power, efficiency and fluctuations.

topics.name: Quantum heat transport and rectification
topics.description: Papers that control heat currents between quantum baths with thermal diodes, valves, transistors and superconducting circuits.

topics.name: Automated quantum dot tuning
topics.description: Papers that automate the tuning and characterisation of quantum dot devices, often with machine learning on charge stability diagrams.

topics.name: Silicon spin qubit control
topics.description: Papers that demonstrate and model gates, readout, shuttling and noise for spin qubits in silicon and germanium quantum dots.

topics.name: Valley splitting and hole spins
topics.description: Papers that model valley splitting, g-tensors and spin-orbit effects in Si/SiGe and germanium hole spin qubits.

topics.name: Geometric and holonomic quantum gates
topics.description: Papers that design nonadiabatic geometric and holonomic gates and make them robust to control errors.

topics.name: Photon-photon and photonic gate schemes
topics.description: Papers that propose deterministic or heralded gates between photonic qubits, often mediated by emitters or cavities.

topics.name: Dynamical decoupling
topics.description: Papers that design and test dynamical decoupling sequences to suppress decoherence and crosstalk during idling and gates.

topics.name: Rydberg gates for neutral atoms
topics.description: Papers that design and demonstrate Rydberg-blockade entangling gates and control for neutral-atom quantum computers.

topics.name: Trapped-ion entangling gates
topics.description: Papers that design and demonstrate high-fidelity two-qubit gates on trapped ions using lasers, microwaves or motional modes.

topics.name: Trapped-ion QCCD architecture and shuttling
topics.description: Papers that compile, schedule and architect shuttling-based trapped-ion quantum computers with multiple zones.

topics.name: Ion trap design and fabrication
topics.description: Papers that design, simulate and fabricate surface-electrode, 3D and Penning traps for trapped-ion quantum computing.

topics.name: GKP and bosonic error-correcting codes
topics.description: Papers that analyse, prepare and decode Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill, cat and other bosonic codes.

topics.name: Rydberg-atom electrometry
topics.description: Papers that use Rydberg atoms in vapour cells as sensitive receivers and sensors of radio-frequency and microwave electric fields.

topics.name: Optically pumped atomic magnetometers
topics.description: Papers that build and model alkali vapour magnetometers and comagnetometers, including SERF and squeezed-light schemes.

topics.name: Neutral atom trapping and tweezer loading
topics.description: Papers that cool, load and image neutral atoms in magneto-optical traps, optical tweezers and lattices.

topics.name: Atomic clocks
topics.description: Papers that build and evaluate optical and microwave atomic clocks, their systematic shifts and frequency comparisons.

topics.name: Trapped-ion laser cooling
topics.description: Papers that cool, measure the temperature of and control motional modes of trapped ions and ion crystals.

topics.name: Quantum sensors for dark matter
topics.description: Papers that propose and run searches for axions, dark photons and ultralight dark matter with qubits, spins and other quantum sensors.

topics.name: Macroscopic spatial superpositions
topics.description: Papers that plan Stern-Gerlach and matter-wave interferometers to put massive nanoparticles into spatial superpositions.

topics.name: Atom interferometry techniques
topics.description: Papers that develop Bragg, Raman and Floquet atom optics and pulse sequences for more sensitive atom interferometers.

topics.name: Atom-interferometric inertial sensors
topics.description: Papers that build atom gravimeters, accelerometers and gyroscopes for field, space and long-baseline use.

topics.name: Magnetic levitation of particles
topics.description: Papers that magnetically levitate superconductors, magnets and microparticles for precision force, gravity and rotation sensing.

topics.name: Gravitational-wave detector quantum noise
topics.description: Papers that reduce quantum noise in gravitational-wave and other large interferometers with squeezing and readout schemes.

topics.name: Optically levitated nanoparticles
topics.description: Papers that trap, cool and squeeze optically levitated nanoparticles for force sensing and macroscopic quantum tests.

topics.name: Quantum-enhanced interferometric phase estimation
topics.description: Papers that compute phase sensitivity of Mach-Zehnder and SU(1,1) interferometers with squeezed, NOON and non-Gaussian states.

topics.name: Entangled two-photon absorption spectroscopy
topics.description: Papers that test and model entangled two-photon absorption and other spectroscopy driven by entangled photon pairs.

topics.name: Orbital angular momentum photons
topics.description: Papers that generate, transform and measure photons and entanglement carrying orbital angular momentum and other spatial modes.

topics.name: Squeezed light generation
topics.description: Papers that generate, characterise and engineer squeezed light from optical parametric oscillators, waveguides and microcombs.

topics.name: Quantum metasurface photon sources
topics.description: Papers that generate and shape entangled photon pairs with nonlinear metasurfaces and thin films.

topics.name: Spatio-temporal SPDC theory
topics.description: Papers that model and characterise the spatial and spectral structure of biphotons from spontaneous parametric down-conversion.

topics.name: Integrated photon-pair sources
topics.description: Papers that build bright entangled photon-pair sources on lithium niobate and other integrated photonic chips.

topics.name: Quantum frequency conversion
topics.description: Papers that convert single photons between emitter wavelengths and telecom bands with low added noise.

topics.name: Quantum dot spin-photon interfaces
topics.description: Papers that control optically active electron and hole spins in quantum dots and entangle them with emitted photons.

topics.name: Quantum electron microscopy and beam shaping
topics.description: Papers that shape free-electron beams with light and bring quantum methods to transmission electron microscopy and imaging.

topics.name: Free electron-photon interactions
topics.description: Papers that study entanglement and quantum state preparation through interactions between free electrons and photons or emitters.

topics.name: Quantum dot excitation and photon cascades
topics.description: Papers that model and demonstrate excitation schemes and biexciton cascades for entangled photons from quantum dots.

topics.name: Quantum dot single-photon sources
topics.description: Papers that build bright, indistinguishable single-photon sources from semiconductor quantum dots in cavities and waveguides.

topics.name: Piezo-optomechanical transducers
topics.description: Papers that design optomechanical crystals and piezoelectric devices to convert quantum signals between microwaves, phonons and light.

topics.name: Quantum acoustics with superconducting qubits
topics.description: Papers that couple superconducting qubits to surface and bulk acoustic wave resonators and itinerant phonons.

topics.name: Optomechanical entanglement and squeezing
topics.description: Papers that propose schemes to entangle mechanical modes with light or each other and to squeeze mechanical motion.

topics.name: Optomechanical force sensing
topics.description: Papers that push optomechanical force and displacement sensing beyond the standard quantum limit with squeezing and backaction evasion.

topics.name: Optomechanical cooling and control
topics.description: Papers that cool and control mechanical resonators through cavity backaction, feedback and engineered optomechanical coupling.

topics.name: Cavity magnomechanics
topics.description: Papers that propose entanglement, squeezing and nonreciprocity in systems coupling magnons, phonons and cavity photons.

topics.name: Magnon-photon coupling
topics.description: Papers that measure and engineer coupling between magnons and microwave or optical cavity photons, including magnon polaritons.

topics.name: Quantum magnonics with qubits
topics.description: Papers that create nonclassical magnon states such as blockade, squeezing and cat states using qubits coupled to magnons.

topics.name: Quantum optics of high-harmonic generation
topics.description: Papers that treat high-harmonic generation and strong-field processes quantum optically, including driving with squeezed or nonclassical light.

topics.name: Photon blockade and nonreciprocity
topics.description: Papers that engineer photon blockade, antibunching and nonreciprocal transmission in cavities and hybrid systems.

topics.name: Spin squeezing
topics.description: Papers that generate spin-squeezed states with one-axis twisting, cavities and dipolar interactions for quantum-enhanced metrology.

topics.name: Jaynes-Cummings model dynamics
topics.description: Papers that solve generalised Jaynes-Cummings models for atom-field dynamics, entanglement and nonclassical field states.

topics.name: Quantum Rabi models
topics.description: Papers that analyse quantum Rabi models and their variants, including deep strong coupling and superradiant phase transitions.

topics.name: Molecular polaritons and polaritonic chemistry
topics.description: Papers that model molecules strongly coupled to optical cavities and how polaritons change spectra and chemical dynamics.

topics.name: Ultrastrong light-matter coupling
topics.description: Papers that develop theory for cavity QED in the ultrastrong regime and cavity control of quantum materials.

topics.name: Superradiance and subradiance
topics.description: Papers that study collective super- and subradiant emission from atomic arrays, ensembles and emitter collectives.

topics.name: Waveguide QED and giant atoms
topics.description: Papers that model emitters and giant atoms coupled to waveguides and structured baths, including bound states and non-Markovian dynamics.

topics.name: NV centre materials and photophysics
topics.description: Papers that create NV centres and study their charge states, spin readout and photophysics in diamond.

topics.name: NV and nanodiamond biosensing
topics.description: Papers that use NV centres and fluorescent nanodiamonds for relaxometry, thermometry and spin detection in cells and biological samples.

topics.name: NV-centre magnetometry
topics.description: Papers that build and improve NV-centre magnetometers, from single-spin scanning probes to ensemble and microwave field sensors.

topics.name: Boron-vacancy spin defects in hBN
topics.description: Papers that characterise and control boron-vacancy and other spin defects in hexagonal boron nitride for sensing.

topics.name: Quantum emitters in hBN
topics.description: Papers that create and characterise single-photon emitters in hexagonal boron nitride and study their coherence and spectra.

topics.name: Rare-earth ions in solids
topics.description: Papers that study erbium, europium and other rare-earth dopants in crystals as optical spin qubits, photon sources and memories.

topics.name: Colour centres in silicon
topics.description: Papers that develop T, G and other telecom colour centres in silicon as spin-photon interfaces.

topics.name: Spin defects in silicon carbide
topics.description: Papers that characterise vacancy and divacancy spin defects in silicon carbide and integrate them with devices and cavities.

topics.name: Group-IV diamond centres in nanophotonics
topics.description: Papers that couple tin-, silicon- and germanium-vacancy centres in diamond to cavities and photonic circuits as spin-photon interfaces.

topics.name: Excitons in 2D semiconductors
topics.description: Papers that model and measure excitons, trions and polaritons in transition-metal dichalcogenide monolayers and moiré heterostructures.

topics.name: Radical-pair magnetoreception
topics.description: Papers that model the radical-pair mechanism behind avian magnetoreception and other biological magnetic field effects.

topics.name: Molecular spin qubits
topics.description: Papers that design molecular electron spins and single-molecule magnets as qubits, qudits and quantum sensors.

topics.name: NMR and nuclear hyperpolarisation
topics.description: Papers that develop NMR methods, dynamic nuclear polarisation and parahydrogen hyperpolarisation, often with quantum sensors.

topics.name: Chirality-induced spin selectivity
topics.description: Papers that explain and model chirality-induced spin selectivity in chiral molecules, junctions and nanowires.

topics.name: Enantiomer detection and separation
topics.description: Papers that use cyclic three-level transitions, laser pulses and cavities to detect and separate chiral molecule enantiomers.

topics.name: Rydberg many-body dynamics
topics.description: Papers that study non-equilibrium and dissipative many-body dynamics of interacting Rydberg atoms and ions.

topics.name: Rydberg state control and interfaces
topics.description: Papers that prepare, image and control Rydberg excitations, circular states and Rydberg-photon interfaces in arrays and ensembles.

topics.name: Rydberg array quantum phases
topics.description: Papers that map ground-state phases of Rydberg atom arrays, such as dimer, spin-liquid and supersolid phases.

topics.name: Photosynthetic and excitonic energy transfer
topics.description: Papers that model coherent exciton and energy transfer in light-harvesting complexes and molecular aggregates with open-system methods.

topics.name: Ultrafast and strong-field molecular dynamics
topics.description: Papers that simulate and image attosecond and femtosecond electron and nuclear dynamics in molecules after ionisation or laser excitation.

topics.name: Ultralong-range Rydberg molecules
topics.description: Papers that study trilobite, butterfly and macrodimer Rydberg molecules and Rydberg interactions with polar molecules.

topics.name: Molecular rotation and orientation control
topics.description: Papers that use shaped laser pulses to orient, align and control the rotational and vibrational states of molecules.

topics.name: Cold molecule spectroscopy and precision tests
topics.description: Papers that trap, cool and probe molecules and molecular ions for precision spectroscopy and electron EDM searches.

topics.name: Nonadiabatic molecular dynamics methods
topics.description: Papers that develop surface hopping, exact factorisation and ring-polymer methods for coupled electron-nuclear dynamics.

topics.name: Electronic structure theory
topics.description: Papers that develop density functional, reduced density matrix and coupled-cluster methods for electronic structure calculations.

topics.name: Magnetic and optical skyrmions
topics.description: Papers that study quantum skyrmions in magnets and optical fields, including skyrmion qubits and topological noise robustness.

topics.name: Majorana zero modes
topics.description: Papers that model, detect and braid Majorana zero modes in Kitaev chains, nanowires and quantum simulators.

topics.name: Chern insulators and fractional Hall states
topics.description: Papers that study Chern insulators, fractional quantum Hall and fractional Chern states, their invariants and edges.

topics.name: Graphene and twisted bilayers
topics.description: Papers that model electronic bands, topology and correlations in graphene, twisted bilayer graphene and moiré systems.

topics.name: Van der Waals magnets and spintronics
topics.description: Papers that study magnetic topological insulators, van der Waals magnets, spin textures and spin-orbit torque in layered materials.

topics.name: Non-Hermitian band topology
topics.description: Papers that classify non-Hermitian topological phases, invariants and bulk-boundary correspondence beyond the skin effect.

topics.name: Non-Hermitian skin effect
topics.description: Papers that analyse and observe the non-Hermitian skin effect, where bulk eigenstates pile up at boundaries.

topics.name: Topological pumping and photonic edge states
topics.description: Papers that study SSH models, topological pumping and edge states in photonic, atomic and quantum optical lattices.

topics.name: Floquet topological phases
topics.description: Papers that study topological phases of periodically driven systems, including anomalous Floquet phases and their detection.

topics.name: Kondo and quantum impurity models
topics.description: Papers that solve Kondo and Anderson impurity models and their real-time dynamics with numerical and analytical methods.

topics.name: Dicke model phase transitions
topics.description: Papers that analyse superradiant and dissipative phase transitions in Dicke models and their generalisations.

topics.name: Quantum spin liquids and frustrated magnets
topics.description: Papers that study spin liquids, Kitaev magnets and frustrated lattice models, including their realisation on quantum simulators.

topics.name: Quantum and dynamical phase transitions
topics.description: Papers that study equilibrium, excited-state and dynamical quantum phase transitions, mostly in Ising-type spin chains.

topics.name: Kibble-Zurek defect formation
topics.description: Papers that test Kibble-Zurek scaling of defects created when quenching across a quantum phase transition.

topics.name: Hubbard models and superconductivity
topics.description: Papers that study Fermi-Hubbard and t-J models, doping, pairing and magnetism in materials and cold-atom simulators.

topics.name: Bose-Hubbard phases
topics.description: Papers that map superfluid, Mott and density-wave phases of Bose-Hubbard and dipolar boson lattice models.

topics.name: Polarons and impurities in quantum gases
topics.description: Papers that study Bose and Fermi polarons and mobile impurities immersed in ultracold gases.

topics.name: Bose-Einstein condensate dynamics
topics.description: Papers that model Bose-Einstein condensates, superfluidity, vortices and turbulence in quantum gases.

topics.name: Quantum droplets and dipolar supersolids
topics.description: Papers that study quantum droplets, supersolids and dipolar Bose gases beyond mean field.

topics.name: Many-body transport and hydrodynamics
topics.description: Papers that study diffusive, superdiffusive and KPZ transport and emergent hydrodynamics in quantum spin and fermion chains.

topics.name: Floquet engineering
topics.description: Papers that model and engineer periodically driven quantum systems, including effective Hamiltonians, prethermalisation and dissipation.

topics.name: Time crystals
topics.description: Papers that study discrete, continuous and dissipative time crystals and observe them on quantum devices.

topics.name: Quantum many-body scars
topics.description: Papers that construct and observe many-body scar states that avoid thermalisation, such as in the PXP model.

topics.name: Hilbert space fragmentation
topics.description: Papers that study how kinetic constraints and symmetries fragment Hilbert space and slow thermalisation.

topics.name: Many-body and Anderson localisation
topics.description: Papers that study Anderson and many-body localisation transitions in disordered spin chains, circuits and graphs.

topics.name: Quasiperiodic localisation and mobility edges
topics.description: Papers that find mobility edges and reentrant localisation in quasiperiodic and non-Hermitian lattices.

topics.name: Quantum cellular automata
topics.description: Papers that build quantum and probabilistic cellular automata and relate them to Dirac dynamics and field theories.

topics.name: Krylov complexity and operator growth
topics.description: Papers that use Krylov complexity, Lanczos coefficients and spread complexity to characterise operator and state growth.

topics.name: Dual-unitary circuits
topics.description: Papers that use dual-unitary and space-time dual circuits as exactly solvable models of chaotic many-body dynamics.

topics.name: Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev models
topics.description: Papers that study chaos, thermodynamics and holographic features of SYK models and their sparse and open variants.

topics.name: Quantum billiards
topics.description: Papers that compare classical and quantum chaos in billiards through spectral statistics, eigenstates and OTOCs.

topics.name: Information scrambling and OTOCs
topics.description: Papers that measure information scrambling with out-of-time-ordered correlators and Loschmidt echoes in closed and open systems.

topics.name: Random matrix spectral statistics
topics.description: Papers that use random matrix theory, level spacings and spectral form factors to diagnose quantum chaos.

topics.name: Semiclassical and dissipative chaos
topics.description: Papers that relate classical chaos and Lyapunov exponents to quantum behaviour in kicked, few-body and dissipative systems.

topics.name: Holographic codes and bulk reconstruction
topics.description: Papers that model AdS/CFT bulk reconstruction with holographic error-correcting codes and random tensor networks.

topics.name: Holographic entropy inequalities
topics.description: Papers that characterise the holographic entropy cone and the entropy inequalities obeyed by holographic states.

topics.name: PEPS and 2D tensor networks
topics.description: Papers that optimise, evolve and contract projected entangled-pair states for two- and three-dimensional systems.

topics.name: Tree tensor networks and software
topics.description: Papers that develop tree tensor networks, time evolution schemes and software packages for tensor network simulation.

topics.name: Matrix product state theory
topics.description: Papers that study the structure, renormalisation and representational power of matrix product states and operators.

topics.name: Entanglement in non-Hermitian systems
topics.description: Papers that use entanglement entropy and its scaling to characterise criticality and transitions in non-Hermitian many-body systems.

topics.name: Quantum simulation of lattice gauge theories
topics.description: Papers that design algorithms and encodings to simulate Abelian and non-Abelian lattice gauge theories on quantum computers.

topics.name: String breaking and confinement dynamics
topics.description: Papers that simulate and observe string breaking, confinement and meson dynamics in lattice gauge theories on quantum hardware.

topics.name: Integrable spin chains
topics.description: Papers that build and solve integrable models with Bethe ansatz, Yang-Baxter equations and conserved charges.

topics.name: Geometric phases and quantum geometry
topics.description: Papers that study Berry phases, quantum geometric tensors and geometric formulations of quantum dynamics in closed and open systems.

topics.name: Many-body entanglement entropy
topics.description: Papers that compute entanglement entropy, negativity and symmetry-resolved entanglement in critical and quenched many-body systems.

topics.name: Anyonic and fractional statistics
topics.description: Papers that construct and realise anyons with fractional exchange statistics, especially in one-dimensional lattice models.

topics.name: Symmetry-protected and generalised symmetry phases
topics.description: Papers that classify SPT phases, anomalies and non-invertible or categorical symmetries in lattice models.

topics.name: Non-Abelian anyons and topological order
topics.description: Papers that create, braid and classify anyons and topological orders, including mixed-state order and string-net states.

topics.name: Twisted electrons and relativistic vortex states
topics.description: Papers that model vortex electron wave packets and twisted particles in strong fields, scattering and radiation.

topics.name: Optical vortex light-matter interaction
topics.description: Papers that study how optical vortex and vector beams transfer orbital angular momentum to atoms, ions and media.

topics.name: Electromagnetic vacuum fluctuations
topics.description: Papers that study vacuum field fluctuations, radiation reaction and motion-induced radiation near mirrors and moving bodies.

topics.name: Schwinger pair production
topics.description: Papers that compute electron-positron pair creation from vacuum in strong, pulsed and chirped electric fields.

topics.name: Casimir energy in field theory
topics.description: Papers that compute Casimir vacuum energy for scalar, Dirac and lattice fields under different boundary conditions.

topics.name: Casimir and Casimir-Polder forces
topics.description: Papers that measure and model Casimir and Casimir-Polder forces between real materials, including friction and nonequilibrium effects.

topics.name: Bound-state QED and exotic atoms
topics.description: Papers that calculate QED, relativistic and nuclear-size corrections in hydrogen-like ions, muonic atoms and positron binding.

topics.name: Aharonov-Bohm effect
topics.description: Papers that reinterpret, generalise and test the Aharonov-Bohm effect and the physical role of vector potentials.

topics.name: PT-symmetric quantum systems
topics.description: Papers that simulate and use PT- and anti-PT-symmetric Hamiltonians in qubits, photonics and state transfer.

topics.name: Pseudo-Hermitian quantum theory
topics.description: Papers that develop the mathematical framework of non-Hermitian and pseudo-Hermitian quantum mechanics, observables and metrics.

topics.name: Exceptional points
topics.description: Papers that create, classify and observe exceptional points and their dynamics in non-Hermitian and open quantum systems.

topics.name: Exceptional-point and non-Hermitian sensing
topics.description: Papers that test whether exceptional points and non-Hermitian dynamics really enhance sensor precision, using quantum Fisher information.

topics.name: Few-body physics and Efimov states
topics.description: Papers that solve two-, three- and four-body problems with contact interactions, including Efimov physics and scattering lengths.

topics.name: Formulations of quantum mechanics
topics.description: Papers that reformulate quantum mechanics and relate it to classical mechanics through trajectories, actions and hydrodynamics.

topics.name: Wigner function and phase-space methods
topics.description: Papers that develop Wigner functions and other phase-space representations for quantum dynamics.

topics.name: Relativistic wave equations
topics.description: Papers that study the Dirac and related relativistic equations, their interpretation, symmetries and field quantisation.

topics.name: Dunkl quantum mechanics
topics.description: Papers that solve oscillators and wave equations with Dunkl derivatives involving reflection operators.

topics.name: Generalised coherent states
topics.description: Papers that construct generalised coherent states and ladder operators for oscillators and other algebraic systems.

topics.name: Potential scattering theory
topics.description: Papers that develop transfer matrix and other methods for quantum and wave scattering from potentials.

topics.name: Bound states of model potentials
topics.description: Papers that solve Schrödinger, Klein-Gordon and Dirac equations for bound states of Coulomb-like and other model potentials.

topics.name: Exactly solvable potentials and oscillators
topics.description: Papers that find exact and approximate spectra of anharmonic oscillators and solvable potentials using supersymmetry, WKB and polynomials.

topics.name: Information thermodynamics and erasure
topics.description: Papers that bound the thermodynamic cost of erasure and information processing, including Maxwell demons and second-law formulations.

topics.name: Entropy production and fluctuation theorems
topics.description: Papers that define and measure entropy production, fluctuation theorems and thermodynamic uncertainty relations in open quantum systems.

topics.name: Quantum work statistics
topics.description: Papers that define and measure quantum work distributions, Jarzynski equalities and quasiprobability approaches to work.

topics.name: Work extraction and ergotropy
topics.description: Papers that bound extractable work and ergotropy and the roles of coherence and correlations as thermodynamic resources.

topics.name: Quantum Mpemba effect
topics.description: Papers that predict and observe faster relaxation or symmetry restoration from initial states further from equilibrium.

topics.name: Quantum speed limits
topics.description: Papers that derive and test quantum speed limits on state, operator and open-system evolution.

topics.name: Quantum Zeno and anti-Zeno effects
topics.description: Papers that analyse Zeno and anti-Zeno effects from frequent measurement and use Zeno dynamics for control.

topics.name: Quantum thermometry
topics.description: Papers that design probes and protocols for estimating temperature with quantum Fisher information, often at low temperatures.

topics.name: Critical quantum metrology
topics.description: Papers that use quantum phase transitions and criticality to enhance parameter estimation precision.

topics.name: Lieb-Robinson bounds
topics.description: Papers that prove Lieb-Robinson bounds, light cones and propagation speed limits for many-body and open quantum systems.

topics.name: Leggett-Garg inequalities
topics.description: Papers that test macrorealism through Leggett-Garg inequality violations in qubits, fields and continuous-variable systems.

topics.name: Decoherence and entanglement dynamics
topics.description: Papers that track how coherence, entanglement and quantum correlations evolve when small systems couple to noisy environments.

topics.name: Gibbs sampling and thermal state preparation
topics.description: Papers that design quantum algorithms and Lindbladian dynamics to prepare thermal states and sample Gibbs distributions.

topics.name: Open quantum system master equations
topics.description: Papers that derive and solve Markovian and non-Markovian master equations and simulation methods for open quantum dynamics.

topics.name: Quantum tunnelling and tunnelling time
topics.description: Papers that model tunnelling through barriers and double wells and the time a particle spends tunnelling.

topics.name: Thermalisation and the ETH
topics.description: Papers that study how closed many-body systems thermalise, testing the eigenstate thermalisation hypothesis.

topics.name: Measurement-induced phase transitions
topics.description: Papers that study entanglement transitions in monitored circuits and continuously measured many-body systems.

topics.name: Quantum arrival times
topics.description: Papers that define and measure when a quantum particle arrives at a detector, including Bohmian and POVM approaches.

topics.name: Mathematical structure of quantum theory
topics.description: Papers that reconstruct or axiomatise quantum theory and examine Hilbert spaces, observables and operator algebras.

topics.name: History and ontology of quantum physics
topics.description: Papers that revisit the history of quantum theory and early debates about the reality of the wave function.

topics.name: Bohmian mechanics
topics.description: Papers that develop, test and debate Bohmian trajectories, pilot-wave models and their relativistic extensions.

topics.name: Quantum reference frames
topics.description: Papers that develop quantum reference frames, relational frame changes and the Page-Wootters approach to time.

topics.name: Born rule derivations
topics.description: Papers that derive, justify or test the Born rule for quantum probabilities.

topics.name: Quantum causal inference
topics.description: Papers that model causal structures with quantum latent variables and test nonclassicality in causal networks.

topics.name: Indefinite causal order
topics.description: Papers that study process matrices, the quantum switch and indefinite causal order in quantum processes.

topics.name: Interpreting Bell's theorem
topics.description: Papers that argue over what Bell's theorem and Bell experiments imply about locality, realism and hidden variables.

topics.name: Quantum contextuality
topics.description: Papers that develop Kochen-Specker and generalised contextuality, noncontextuality inequalities and contextuality as a resource.

topics.name: Interpretations and the measurement problem
topics.description: Papers that propose and compare interpretations of quantum mechanics and philosophical accounts of measurement and reality.

topics.name: QBism and observer-centred views
topics.description: Papers that discuss QBism, agents, experience and consciousness in the interpretation of quantum theory.

topics.name: Holographic and Krylov complexity
topics.description: Papers that relate computational and Krylov complexity to black hole interiors and holographic duals.

topics.name: Generalised uncertainty principle
topics.description: Papers that build minimal-length quantum mechanics from generalised uncertainty principles motivated by quantum gravity.

topics.name: Spontaneous collapse models
topics.description: Papers that develop and constrain spontaneous wave-function collapse models such as CSL with experiments.

topics.name: Gravity tests with clocks and collapse
topics.description: Papers that test gravitational time dilation, the equivalence principle and gravity-related collapse with quantum systems.

topics.name: Quantum clocks and time
topics.description: Papers that model quantum clocks, relational and emergent time, and quantum time dilation.

topics.name: Quantum cosmology and curved spacetime
topics.description: Papers that study quantum fields in curved spacetime, quantum cosmology and decoherence of inflationary perturbations.

topics.name: Entanglement near black holes
topics.description: Papers that compute how entanglement, steering and coherence degrade for observers near black holes and in non-inertial frames.

topics.name: Analogue Hawking radiation
topics.description: Papers that model and observe Hawking-like radiation in analogue horizons in fluids, condensates and optics.

topics.name: Black hole information problem
topics.description: Papers that study information loss, Page curves and the recovery of information from evaporating black holes.

topics.name: Gravitons and gravitational decoherence
topics.description: Papers that study graviton noise, quantum signatures of gravitational waves and gravity-induced decoherence.

topics.name: Gravitationally induced entanglement
topics.description: Papers that propose and analyse table-top tests of whether gravity can entangle masses and so must be quantum.

topics.name: Quantum correlations in neutrino oscillations
topics.description: Papers that apply coherence, entanglement and other quantum-information measures to neutrino flavour oscillations and their decoherence.

topics.name: Simulating collective neutrino oscillations
topics.description: Papers that model and quantum-simulate many-body collective neutrino flavour oscillations in dense astrophysical environments.

topics.name: Entanglement at colliders
topics.description: Papers that measure entanglement, Bell violation and quantum tomography in top-quark, Higgs and other collider events.

topics.name: Entanglement in scattering processes
topics.description: Papers that study entanglement generated in particle scattering, from Compton scattering to partons and nucleon interactions.

topics.name: Entanglement harvesting
topics.description: Papers that compute how Unruh-DeWitt detectors extract entanglement from quantum field vacua under different motions and spacetimes.

topics.name: Unruh effect and accelerated detectors
topics.description: Papers that study the Unruh effect and how acceleration affects correlations and coherence of Unruh-DeWitt detectors.

broad.name: Learning quantum systems
broad.description: Papers that learn states, Hamiltonians, entanglement and phases from data, with provable learning algorithms or with neural networks.

broad.name: Quantum machine learning
broad.description: Papers that build, benchmark and apply quantum machine-learning models (kernels, neural networks, generative models, reservoirs) to classical data.

broad.name: Quantum computing for finance
broad.description: Papers that apply quantum algorithms and quantum machine learning to pricing, risk, portfolio selection and financial prediction.

broad.name: Language, education and culture
broad.description: Papers on large language models and NLP meeting quantum computing, quantum education and workforce, music, and quantum-like models of cognition.

broad.name: Simulation, annealing and ground states
broad.description: Papers on simulating many-body and molecular systems on quantum hardware, adiabatic and annealing algorithms, and classical simulation of noisy circuits.

broad.name: Quantum optimal control
broad.description: Papers that design control fields and pulses for state preparation and gates, analytically, numerically and with robustness to errors.

broad.name: Reinforcement learning
broad.description: Papers that use reinforcement learning to control quantum systems and compile circuits, or build quantum versions of reinforcement-learning agents.

broad.name: Biology and drug discovery
broad.description: Papers that apply quantum optimisation and simulation to protein structure, docking, drug design and genomic sequence problems.

broad.name: Optimisation and scientific computing
broad.description: Papers on QAOA, QUBOs and industrial optimisation, variational-algorithm training, and quantum algorithms for linear algebra and differential equations.

broad.name: Quantum error correction
broad.description: Papers on error-correcting codes, decoders, fault-tolerant gadgets, magic states and error mitigation.

broad.name: Systems, simulators and benchmarks
broad.description: Papers on classical simulators of quantum circuits, compilation and routing, distributed and HPC-integrated execution, and benchmarking of quantum computers.

broad.name: Circuits, compilation and programming
broad.description: Papers on circuit synthesis and decomposition, state preparation, arithmetic and Fourier circuits, Shor's algorithm, programming languages, testing and ZX-calculus.

broad.name: Entanglement and nonlocality
broad.description: Papers that detect, quantify and classify entanglement, and study Bell nonlocality in standard, network and LOCC settings.

broad.name: Entropies, divergences and Markov dynamics
